scriptLines: admission_date = iif(     isNull(admission_date) || trim(admission_date) == '',     toDate(null()),     iif(         regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 '20',                 right(trim(admission_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(admission_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(admission_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),         coalesce(             toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),             toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),             toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yyyy')         )     ) ),

discharge_date = iif(     isNull(discharge_date) || trim(discharge_date) == '',     toDate(null()),     iif(         regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 '20',                 right(trim(discharge_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(discharge_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(discharge_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),         coalesce(             toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),             toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),             toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yyyy')         )     ) ),

department = iif(     isNull(department) || trim(department) == '',     toString(null()),     iif(         upper(trim(department)) == 'ONCO' ||         upper(trim(department)) == 'ONCOLOGYY' ||         upper(trim(department)) == 'ONCOLOGY',         'Oncology',         iif(             upper(trim(department)) == 'CARDIOLGY' ||             upper(trim(department)) == 'CARDIO' ||             upper(trim(department)) == 'CARDIOLOGY',             'Cardiology',             iif(                 upper(trim(department)) == 'EMERGANCY' ||                 upper(trim(department)) == 'ER' ||                 upper(trim(department)) == 'EMERGENCY',                 'Emergency',                 iif(                     upper(trim(department)) == 'GEN SURG' ||                     upper(trim(department)) == 'GENERALSURGERY' ||                     upper(trim(department)) == 'GENERAL SURGERY',                     'General Surgery',                     iif(                         upper(trim(department)) == 'ORTHO' ||                         upper(trim(department)) == 'ORTHOPEDICS',                         'Orthopedics',                         iif(                             upper(trim(department)) == 'PAEDIATRICS' ||                             upper(trim(department)) == 'PEDIATRICS',                             'Pediatrics',                             iif(                                 upper(trim(department)) == 'NEUROLOGY',                                 'Neurology',                                 trim(department)                             )                         )                     )                 )             )         )     ) ),
